lines.en: label christmasotoha1:
scene otohapresent1
: I am so full of love...and so full of cum.
: Yeah. Well, I hope you’re very proud of yourself for probably ruining Kirin’s night.
scene otohapresent2
: Hey. It takes two to tango, Sensei. Unless you’re me alone in my bed, thinking about you. Then you can tango alone. But you need to wait until Chinami is asleep or she’ll ask questions.
: How long were you even watching us for? And...from where?
: I followed you.
scene otohapresent3
: Why?
: Love, of course! I didn’t want Kirin luring you into a dark room and taking advantage of you. It wasn’t until after that I learned you love her too. Which made it okay!
scene otohapresent4
: Why do you think she left, though? She’s been joking about getting into my pants lately too. I figured she’d be super excited to watch me watch her.
: Well, how would you feel if people started showing up to watch us? And one of them just happened to be someone claiming to be the cuckquean ringleader of my harem?
: I’d just go along with it and let them think whatever they want to think because I know I’m the only one who matters in the end and I love dick.
: Can you please just...leave me alone next time? Or find a way to ask me without potentially traumatizing another girl who’s just trying to have a moment?
scene otohapresent5
: So let them think they’re winning. Got it! I’ll be more careful next time.
scene otohapresent6
: For now, I’ll just be happy we got to have a lot of hot Christmas sex. Apparently, I’ve seemed kind of crazy today- and I imagine that will now begin to fade since I am low on energy.
: I know you, so I know damn well you are assuredly not low on energy after only three orgasms.
scene otohapresent7
: You’re right! Let’s go back and do it again!
: Do what again?
scene otohapresent8
: What are you guys talking about?
: Sensei, do you “love” Otoha too?
: Of course not.
: Wow. Okay, man. Merry Christmas to you too.
: I’ll just keep my mouth shut and continue to hate her then.
scene otohapresent9
: Wouldn’t it make more sense for you to just...stop hating me since I barely even talk to Rin anymore and we’re in a club together?
: Yeah. But nothing makes sense anymore, so you’re just going to have to deal with it.
: Merry Christmas, Sensei.
scene okayitsgametimeagain1
scene otohapresent9
: Is something wrong? You look like you’ve just seen a ghost.
: Is it weird for me to want to hug you really hard right now?
scene otohapresent10
: Not at all. I was actually just picturing what a passionate night in your arms would feel like. So please, have at this body like a father claiming his daughter’s innocence in the dead of night.
: What the heck, Sensei? You didn’t even try to hug me once we finished doing all of those chores together a few minutes ago.
: What a believable story. Is this really the place to be doing chores, though?

: Chika, since you’re not effectively and immediately coming up with a coping mechanism this time, just tell yourself it’s because the two of you are wearing the same outfit and I...mistook her for you or something.
scene otohapresent11
: Hey, yeah! Who do you think you are showing up in that? I’m supposed to be the hot Santa girl. You’re not allowed to wear that unless I ask you to like I did with Rin.

: Oh, this? I merely walked into the first discount costume store I could find and grabbed something I believed would be appealing to Daddy dearest. I sincerely apologize if you employed the same strategy.
: That-
scene otohapresent12
: I don’t really...have the...
: I like the costume, Chika.
scene otohapresent13
: Aah! Thank you, Sensei! I-
: Now go head back to the Christmas party before me so no one gets the wrong idea. Okay?
scene otohapresent14
: Done. I read you loud and clear, Sensei. Always thinking ahead of the game. This is why you’re my best friend.
: Mhm. I’ll see you later, Chika. Have fun at the party. And tell Kirin to come talk to me if you see her.
: I’ll think about it.
scene otohapresent15
Chika leaves.
I never really wanted her to show up in the first place, to be honest.
: You know it’s frowned upon to screw those who aren’t mentally stable enough to consent, right?
: I do a lot of things that are frowned upon, Otoha.
: Something, something, laws. Something, something, who cares? None of us do. That’s for sure.
: Are you two just showing up now?
: Yeah. I had to stop somewhere first. And Nodoka was weirdly insistent on getting a slutty Christmas outfit for whatever reason.
scene otohapresent16
: Do I need a reason to want to look my best for a reunion with my beloved?
: So, Sensei is your “beloved” now?
: She could be talking about Jesus. He is technically supposed to be everywhere and today is kind of his unofficial birthday.
: He’s right, you know. And I can think of no better pair to tie me up and spitroast me until I can no longer see or breathe.
: That sounds fun, but I’m pretty sure it would be a sin.
scene otohapresent17
: The greatest joys in life typically are.
: Should I just leave so you can claim her next? Because I feel like that’s the direction we’re headed in right now and I’m not sure I want to stick around to see it.
: There’s no need, Otoha. I was actually just leaving.
scene otohapresent18
: What? We literally just got here.
: And my job is already done. I’m so good at this.
: Good at what? You’ve been-
: Nodoka.
scene otohapresent19
: Yes, Father?
: Are you okay?
scene otohapresent20
: Never better.
scene black
Nodoka leaves and suddenly it’s just Otoha and me.
She briefly flashes me a look that says something along the lines of, “What the fuck was that about?” And, you know what? I wish I had an answer for her.
Maybe it’s because I’ve been talking to monks. Maybe having that space between Nodoka’s legs as a failsafe to hide in if things get really bad is what’s making me thankful for her right now.
Maybe it’s a whole slew of things — memories from lives unlived or dreams of days that shan’t ever come.
Or maybe it’s just love for her too.
Who even knows at this point?
That dam I call restraint is wearing thin...and each mask on the wall is cracked or chipped.
Something about the way she’s shaped just lets her slip right through.
scene otohapresent21
I should probably be thinking about Otoha right now, though, since she’s the one standing before me.
: You and her make a weird pair.
: Which one? Chika or Nodoka?
: Yes.
: Fair enough. I make a weird pair with basically everyone.
: Probably because you’re like six times everyone else’s age.
: I can always count on you to make me feel even older than I actually am, Otoha. Thank you.
: Don’t sweat it, man. Can you use all those years of wisdom and your allegedly superior intellect to figure out what the hell’s going on with her, though?
: Who accused me of having superior intellect? I need to have a word with them.
: You don’t know then?

: About what? Nodoka? Sorry, but no. I haven’t spent any actual time with her in months. But if she’s being weird, I think it’s probably safe to assume that she’s just...you know. Literally being weird.
scene otohapresent22

: Yeah...maybe. I guess trying to pull any logic out of that black box of a mind is kind of pointless. If you, me, or Futaba have no idea what’s going on, it’s probably just safe to say no one ever will.
: Probably. But hey, if you want to try and psychoanalyze me instead, have at it. You’ve got your work cut out for you today.
scene otohapresent23
: And I don’t on a normal day?
: On normal days, I’m not hallucinating chipmunks.
: And...that is a thing you’re doing today?
: Sure is. Any guesses as to what’s wrong with me this time?
scene otohapresent24

: It’s clearly a sign that you want to stop sleeping with teenage girls and start doing the right thing. And also that you want to buy me a new amp. And whatever else I want. Maybe dinner if the buffet here isn’t good?
: No actual guesses then?
: Man, you really want to keep sleeping with all those teenagers then, huh? Not going to heed the advice of your holiday guardian angel, Otoha Okakura?
: You’re a terrible guardian angel if you only show up on holidays. Especially since my tragedy rate seems to skyrocket whenever they roll around.
: I do what I can.
: You historically do not.
scene otohapresent25
: These chipmunks — what are their names?
: Malvin, Diamond, and Spork.
: Spork?
: A glutton, he is.
: You have a weird fucking mind, Sensei. Especially since I know at this point that you’re almost definitely not lying to me right now.
: I feel like...having Ami around would at least kind of keep me grounded. But she’s-
: Out with Niki. I know. I stopped getting invited after trying to kiss her in a locker room.
: You can kiss me instead if you want. I promise I won’t tell anyone.
: Smooth. That line will go over really well in jail one day.
: I take it that’s a no then?
: It’s definitely a no.
scene otohapresent26
: Here’s a consolation prize, though.
: A present? Where were you even keeping-
: Don’t worry about it. Just take it.
scene otohapresent27
I swipe the gift from Otoha’s hands. It feels light. So light, in fact, that I’m doubtful there’s anything in it at all.
: Can I open it now?
: You actually can’t open it at all.
: It’s just the wrapping paper, isn’t it?
: No. I just mean that isn’t actually for you. It’s for Niki. I want you to give it to her for me since I’m not seeing her until after the holidays are over.
: Ahh, okay. So you just lied to me about this being a consolation prize then.
: Not technically. For a second, I bet you were thinking something like, “Wow! Otoha must really care about me if she bought me a present. What a kind and thoughtful girl she is.”
: That moment of bliss was a prize on its own, wasn’t it?
: Yeah. Only for a moment, though. Now, I just think you’re evil.
: I’m evil for not buying you a present? Or for leading you into believing I got you a present just to send your dreams crashing back down to earth?
: The latter.
scene otohapresent26
: Well, I guess it’s time to really rock your world then. Because this one is for you, Sensei.
: Go on. Take it. I promise I’m not fucking with you this time.
: I can really have that?
: Did my five-second prank really scar you so badly that you’re afraid to even take a gift out of my hands now?
scene otohapresent27
I swipe this gift from Otoha too, and it feels exponentially heavier than the last one.
: Something wrong?
: No, I just...didn’t get you anything.
: I guess I’m just a better person than you, then.
: All I have to repay you with is my body.
: Why don’t we just call it even?
I tear open the gift.
scene otohapresent28
Oh my fucking god.
: Is this some kind of inside joke or something?
: Do you not like it?
: Imani just got me this exact same pocket knife. What kind of man do you people think I am?
: One who’s really hard to shop for. Noriko actually helped me pick that out. So if you don’t like it, take it up with her.
: That clever bitch is using me as an excuse for free pocket knives, isn’t she?
: She is basically your little sister, isn’t she? Seems like a very “little sister” thing to do. Now, can you stop pointing that at me?
scene otohapresent29
: Yeah, sorry. Thank you anyway, Otoha. You’re one of the last people I expected to get me anything. So-
: Why?
: Why what?
: Why am I one of the last people you expected to get you something?
: Because...you’re arguably less interested in sleeping with me than basically everyone else I know? Apart from a full-blown lesbian, that is.
: So I can’t buy you a present?
: It’s not that. I just-
: Sensei, if I can offer you a piece of advice that isn’t just “stop fucking teenagers,” can I say that...thinking about things in that way is just really fucking sad? Even for you.
scene otohapresent30
: Correlating ulterior motives like whether or not someone wants to screw you to whether or not they care enough to buy you a present is a major fucking bummer, dude.
: I get that everyone and their mother, quite literally at times, is throwing themselves at you. But just because it’s what you’re used to doesn’t mean it’s what’s normal.
: I bought you a gift because I had money and I was thinking about you. And because you’re my friend. And because I thought it might make you feel good or whatever.
: I’m not asking for anything in return either. I just...you know.
: You’ve changed my life.
scene otohapresent31
: Mostly in bad ways. But still. If that sort of impact doesn’t earn you a present, I don’t know what does.
: I’ll get you something too.
: Fine. Just don’t get Noriko to help you pick something out or she’s just going to wind up with another present.
: Well, what do you want? How much do those amp things cost?
: Way more than that knife. You don’t have to worry about it, though. Just come hang out with me sometime. That’ll suffice, I guess.
: You’re actually asking me to hang out? You’re not just going to begrudgingly let me in when I show up at your dorm room unannounced?
: Again with the “Otoha doesn’t actually like me” crap. I do. I really do.
scene otohapresent32
: And honestly, I’ve...felt kind of shitty lately. Maybe putting up with your bullshit will help distract me from all that.
: Well, I can certainly relate there. What kind of “shitty” are we talking about, though? As your “friend,” I feel as if I am obligated to ask.
: General loneliness maybe?
: Feeling shitty about myself?
: Feeling stuck?
scene otohapresent33
: The kind of stuff having a little brother around might help fix.
: And what better person to pick for a little brother than a man in his thirties who is also technically still your teacher on paper?
: Options are limited in Kumon-mi nowadays. I’ll take what I can get.
: And if I start using you as an excuse to trick people into buying me things?
: Honestly?...
: Some days, I think I’d kill for something like that.
: Well, you’re in luck. Because I just happen to have a matching pair of pocket knives that we can cut this city into pieces with.
: Works for me. Can we wait until Christmas is over, though? I want to see how Niki reacts to my gift.
: Oh, sure. I got so caught up in self-deprecation and murder that I forgot you even got her something.
: Still trying to win her over?
: Maybe.
scene black
: Maybe not.
Otoha peels herself off of a column that probably costs more than my house and heads for the door.
It quickly becomes apparent she has no idea where she’s going, though. So she winds up downloading the Tsukioka Manor navigation app while I-
I...try to wrap my head around the act of caring for someone.
I know I can do that. I know I’ve done that. Look at Osako. Look at Imani (at first — not so much anymore).
I’ve proven to myself I can think of them in contexts that don’t require my penis.
I just wonder how much longer it will take to do the same when it comes to me.
We make our way back to the party together, mostly in silence.
My fingers curl around the handle of a blade I never asked for.
But one I wanted nonetheless.
